# Session with Jade Matthew

> Private coaching in confidence, presence and performance, based in London and working online and internationally.

Jade Matthew is an actress with twenty years of professional experience across television, film, radio and video games, with work for the BBC, HBO, Netflix, Channel 4, ITV and Sky and a BBC Audio Drama Award. She is Senior Audio Director at LAMDA, a clinical hypnotherapist and a Master NLP Practitioner, has coached more than 500 people, and created the Performance State Method, which works on inner state and outer performance together.

## Work with Jade
- [Private coaching](https://sessionwithjade.com/private-coaching.html): one to one coaching on confidence, pressure, personal change and patterns.
- [Artists and public figures](https://sessionwithjade.com/artists.html): coaching for actors, musicians, artists and people in the public eye, plus roster support for agents, managers and PRs.
- [Media and performance preparation](https://sessionwithjade.com/media.html): interviews, television, podcasts, press days and appearances.
- [Organisations and leadership](https://sessionwithjade.com/organisations.html): executive coaching and bespoke workshops.
- [Speaking and workshops](https://sessionwithjade.com/speaking.html): keynotes, panels and masterclasses.
- [About Jade](https://sessionwithjade.com/about.html)
- [Private enquiries](https://sessionwithjade.com/enquire.html): jade@thesessionlab.com
